title: Ahead of UP elections, BJP announces new team: Rajnath Singh's son among 19 vice-presidents
summary: The BJP has unveiled its new Uttar Pradesh unit office-bearers, signaling a strategic move ahead of the 2027 assembly elections. Key positions including Vice Presidents, General Secretaries, Secretaries, and Regional Presidents have been filled.
